rootworks.name: The Rootworks
rootworks.blurb: The shared entrance: all seven original types, and the first boss at the bottom.

ember.name: The Ember Abyss
ember.blurb: Lava vents erupt on a beat and leave the floor burning. Rich in ore and Ember creatures.

drowned.name: The Drowned Galleries
drowned.blurb: Water rises room by room. A Tide in your party swims the flooded halls; without one, deep water drags and drowns.

choir.name: The Hollow Choir
choir.blurb: Darkness. Enemies hunt by sound, so firing gives you away. An Echo in your party lets you see.

spires.name: The Glasswind Spires
spires.blurb: Wind lanes push bullets and bodies, and cliff drops wait between rooms. A Gale in your party rides the wind.

sump.name: The Sump
sump.blurb: Poison pools seep across the floors. Creatures caught here carry extra mutations. Home of the Venom type.

warrens.name: Warrens
warrens.desc: A grid of rooms. Clear them and pick your route.

labyrinth.name: Labyrinth
labyrinth.desc: Twisting halls with extra rooms and more secrets.

gauntlet.name: Gauntlet
gauntlet.desc: A chain of arena rooms. The doors behind you lock.

sinkhole.name: Sinkhole
sinkhole.desc: Rooms you leave collapse after a while. Keep moving.

flood.name: Flood
flood.desc: Rooms fill with water over time.

nest.name: Nest
nest.desc: A wild colony fills one great room. Bring cages.

caravan.name: Caravan
caravan.desc: Escort a trader to the extract for a large payout.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.desc: Shadow copies of your own creatures wait in the rooms.

migration.name: Migration
migration.desc: A herd of one rare species is passing through.

surge.name: Surge
surge.desc: The Bloom turns aggressive: enemies deal 30% more damage and loot doubles.

lostkeeper.name: Lost Keeper
lostkeeper.desc: The echo of a dead Keeper wanders this floor. Follow it to a relic, or fight it for its gear.

rivals.name: Rival Raiders
rivals.desc: Raiders from the Exchange are after the same extract. Rob them before they rob you.

cache.name: Estate Cache
cache.desc: A sealed Keeper camp full of old blueprints.

haul.name: Haul
haul.desc: Extract with at least {n} coin in your bag.

catchType.name: Specimen
catchType.desc: Catch a {type} creature and extract with it.

catchGrade.name: Breeder's order
catchGrade.desc: Catch a creature with {gene} {n} or higher and extract with it.

hunt.name: Hunt
hunt.desc: Defeat {n} enemies in one raid and extract.

elite.name: Warden hunt
elite.desc: Defeat a lair's elite guardian and extract.

lure.name: Lure map
lure.desc: The vein's signature types turn up twice as often, and wild creatures 50% more.

hoard.name: Hoard map
hoard.desc: Marks the caches: +50% coin from enemies and chests.

peril.name: Peril map
peril.desc: The hard way down: enemies +30% health and damage, +60% coin and Keeper XP.
